meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创作或编辑自定义视频合成作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作多场景视频、品牌短片或自由形式的视频合成。
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit custom video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce multi-scene videos, brand sizzle reels, or freeform video builds.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的需求创作或编辑视频，包括多场景短片、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇、静态循环、标题卡、素材混剪等。它会先读取项目状态，然后按步骤规划、构建场景并生成最终视频。
howto.when: 当没有更专门的视频工作流适用，或项目简报（BRIEF.md）指定了“companion”流程时触发。通常在你提出视频创作或编辑需求后开始工作。

say.text: 帮我做一个30秒的品牌宣传片，展示我们的新产品。
say.note: Claude 会启动视频创作流程，先规划再构建。

say.text: 编辑这个现有视频项目，把第二段场景的转场改成淡入淡出。
say.note: Claude 会定位项目并执行具体编辑。

say.text: 把这几段素材混剪成一个蒙太奇，配上背景音乐。
say.note: Claude 会处理素材并合成视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create or edit videos based on your needs, including multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, and footage remixes. It reads project state, then plans, builds scenes, and produces the final video step by step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized video workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Typically starts after you request video creation or editing.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second brand reel showcasing our new product.
say_en.note: Claude will start the video creation workflow, planning then building.

say_en.text: Edit this existing video project, change the transition of scene 2 to fade.
say_en.note: Claude will locate the project and perform the specific edit.

say_en.text: Remix these clips into a montage with background music.
say_en.note: Claude will process the assets and compose the video.
